visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up of a miniature McDonald's sign and delivery box prop in an indoor living room setting with bright indoor lighting. Behind the sign, a blurred Shiba Inu wearing a yellow visor sits on a grey sofa. (2) The camera pans up to show a man in a white t-shirt sitting on the sofa next to the Shiba Inu and a cat. All three are wearing McDonald's-themed red collars and yellow visors. The man gestures with his hands while talking to the pets. (3) A series of quick cuts feature close-ups of the Shiba Inu barking and the cat meowing, with the Shiba Inu wearing a headset and delivery visor. Small McDonald's toy props like a burger box and a delivery bag are placed near them on the sofa. (4) The Shiba Inu runs across the room toward the man, jumping onto the sofa. The man pets the dog's head affectionately. (5) The scene shifts to a product showcase where several miniature McDonald's toy sets are arranged on a tiled floor. These include toy burgers, fries, a drink machine, and a delivery bag. The Shiba Inu sits proudly behind the toys, looking at the camera. (6) A final cut shows the cat looking out of a cardboard prop designed to look like a 'Drive Thru' window, with a toy speaker and tray in front.

A male voice speaks energetically, asking who wants to be a McDonald's delivery person. Short, bubbly 'pop' sound effects play as text appears. (2) Sharp, synthesized 'bark' and 'meow' sounds are layered over the music, representing the pets 'speaking'. A bell stinger rings when the Shiba Inu 'volunteers'. (3) The music maintains a constant 128 BPM beat. The man continues to narrate with high arousal and a friendly tone, while the BGM volume dips slightly during speech. (4) Transition sound effects like 'whooshes' occur during scene cuts. The man's voice changes to a more informative, narrative tone to explain the promotion details. (5) The video ends with a triumphant musical flourish and a final cartoonish 'ding' sound effect as a call to action is presented.
